Title: Baseline verifies
Origin: THE LATEST VERSIONS ALL NEED TO COME TO `pacer3` FORMATTING FOR A BASELINE RELEASE(v3.0.0).
Requirement: Lint, types, tests, manifests, this repository's registers and the kit all pass from one command

Title: One copy per host
Origin: THERES INSTALL SCRIPTS EVERYWHERE, NO IDEA WHATS LEGACY AND WHATS NOT ANYMORE
Requirement: Claude Code and Codex each run exactly pacer@mivim at the current version from this directory

Title: Notice once
Origin: it will prompt the user ONCE that it is out of date, and provide them the update command to pull the latest PACER version. ADDITIONAL it should provide the command to silence that update prompt.
Requirement: A newer version is announced once per version with the update and silence commands; silenced, nothing is checked or shown

Title: Update display
Origin: PLEASE MAKE ITS UPDATE MINIMAL BUT WELL DESIGNED, LIKE AN IMPRESSIVE, PRORPIETARY PROGRESS BAR WHILE IT UPDATES
Requirement: Every stage of an update runs under the Pace Line display, with plain lines when there is no terminal
Probe: uv run --no-project --python ">=3.11" scripts/check.py --tests "display or journey or paceline or prompt"

Title: MIVIM lineage
Origin: for future proofing; the HIERCHAL COMMAND of MIVIM located in: @MIVIM.pipeline
Requirement: The runtime identity matches MIVIM.pipeline: MIVIM, spec, vigiles, agent PACER

Title: Prompts only in a terminal
Origin: IF pacer update is typed without a flag option, the cli should ask the user where; IF no path is provided, the CLI should prompt
Requirement: The chooser and the path field prompt only when stdin and stdout are a live terminal; anywhere else each returns its default so agents and scripts never block

Title: Init enrolls the host
Origin: pacer init --AGENT <path> initiates the project in the correct repository for the correct framework
Requirement: pacer init with --claude or --codex creates .pacer/ in the given project and enrolls it with that host from the installed source; a governed project keeps its registers and is still enrolled

Title: Doctor finds and fixes
Origin: pacer doctor: a debugging and correction command for pacer to fix its framework, pathing, version, or operations
Requirement: pacer doctor reports every check of the machine, the hosts and the project as a row with a verdict, exits non-zero on a failure, and --fix applies each repair it owns
